question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Final answer: product with smallest pct-point change in share among top 20%
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_sales
    WHERE (q4_2019_sales > 0 AND q4_2020_sales >= q4_2019_sales * 1.2)
       OR (q4_2019_sales = 0 AND q4_2020_sales > 0)
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, p.prod_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_1772,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) as sales_1776
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, p.prod_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(sales_1772 + sales_1776) as total_sales
    FROM city_product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top20_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM (
        SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
               NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as tile
        FROM product_totals
    )
    WHERE tile = 1
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, 
           SUM(sales_1772) as total_1772,
           SUM(sales_1776) as total_1776
    FROM city_product_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top20_products)
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
qt AS (
    SELECT SUM(sales_1772) as total_1772, SUM(sales_1776) as total_1776 FROM city_product_sales
)
SELECT p.prod_name,
       1.0 * pqs.total_1772 / qt.total_1772 * 100.0 as share_1772,
       1.0 * pqs.total_1776 / qt.total_1776 * 100.0 as share_1776,
       ABS(1.0 * pqs.total_1776 / qt.total_1776 * 100.0 - 1.0 * pqs.total_1772 / qt.total_1772 * 100.0) as pct_point_change
FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
JOIN products p ON p.prod_id = pqs.prod_id
CROSS JOIN qt
ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC
LIMIT 1
